fusions.name: Road-Long Reach
fusions.desc: Throws an arm that deals 5 damage. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Heel-Down Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps every arm down at once, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Road Unrolled
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

fusions.name: Gait of Eight
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 2 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
